lines.welcome.1: Hi. This course shows you how databases really work, from the basics to what interviewers ask.
lines.welcome.2: No setup and no slides. You'll learn by doing: tapping, predicting, and fixing things.
lines.welcome.ask: First, what are you getting ready for?
lines.welcome.interview: Good. Interviewers love the why behind databases, and that's exactly what you'll practise.
lines.welcome.design: Then the later levels are for you. Replication, sharding and caching all build on the basics here.
lines.welcome.curious: Perfect. Curiosity is the best reason. You'll see how the machine works on the inside.
lines.welcome.3: Either way, we start small and build up.
lines.story.1: Everything happens in one place: Maya's bakery.
lines.story.2: It starts with a paper notebook. You'll learn to shape data so it stays correct.
lines.story.3: Then the bakery goes online, on one server. You'll see how a database stores, finds and protects every order.
lines.story.4: Then it becomes a chain, with many stores and lots of traffic. You'll learn to scale without losing data.
lines.story.5: For roles that go deeper, an elective level looks at specific database engines.
lines.story.6: Every new idea arrives as the bakery's next real problem.
lines.how.1: Every lesson plays like this one. I explain, and the pictures move with me.
lines.how.2: Then it's your turn. When the film stops, the next move is yours.
lines.how.3: At the end, an interviewer checks what stuck. It sounds like this.

how.interviewer.caption: Why can a query that returns twelve rows still read ten pages from disk?
how.interviewer.speaker: interviewer

lines.how.4: You'll be able to answer that very soon.
lines.how.speed-ask: Before we go on, find your pace. Tap the speed button below.
lines.how.speed-hint: It's the button showing the playback speed, at the bottom.
lines.how.speed-ok: Nice. You can change it, pause, or mute me whenever you like.
lines.how.5: Prefer to read at your own pace? Switch to Guided at the top. For free play, there's Explore.
lines.path.1: Here's your path, from the first notebook to a whole chain of stores.
lines.path.2: Each stop is a module. Finish a lesson's labs, and it's checked off.
lines.path.3: Your progress stays in this browser, so you can come back anytime.
lines.path.ask: Ready? Tap the first stop to begin.
lines.path.hint: The first stop is the glowing one.
lines.path.go: Let's start with Maya's notebook. See you there.
